parameters.query:
SELECT r.role_id,r.company_id,c.name AS company,r.catalog_version,r.role_title,
       r.deadline::text,r.required_skills,r.preferred_skills,
       encode(sha256(convert_to(to_jsonb(r)::text,'UTF8')),'hex') AS role_sha256,
       d.document_key,d.source_version,d.source_title,d.content,d.content_sha256
FROM public.internship_roles r
JOIN public.companies c USING(company_id)
LEFT JOIN public.role_documents d ON d.company_id=r.company_id AND d.source_version=r.catalog_version
  AND d.index_status<>'retired'
WHERE r.active AND c.active
ORDER BY r.role_id;

-- A single SQL statement is one atomic transaction. All parameters are bound, never interpolated.
WITH incoming AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(text text,metadata jsonb,embedding text)
), locked AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('firstrole-final-knowledge-index',0))
), valid AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT i.* FROM incoming i CROSS JOIN locked
  JOIN public.internship_roles r ON r.role_id=i.metadata->>'role_id'
  JOIN public.companies c ON c.company_id=r.company_id
  JOIN public.role_documents d ON d.document_key=i.metadata->>'document_key'
    AND d.source_version=(i.metadata->>'source_version')::integer AND d.company_id=r.company_id
  WHERE r.active AND c.active AND d.index_status<>'retired'
    AND c.name=i.metadata->>'company'
    AND r.catalog_version=(i.metadata->>'catalog_version')::integer
    AND d.source_version=r.catalog_version
    AND d.content_sha256=i.metadata->>'source_sha256'
    AND encode(sha256(convert_to(to_jsonb(r)::text,'UTF8')),'hex')=i.metadata->>'role_sha256'
), complete AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT count(*)>0 AND count(*)=(SELECT count(*) FROM incoming)
    AND count(*)=(SELECT count(DISTINCT metadata->>'role_id') FROM incoming)
    AND count(*)=(SELECT count(*) FROM public.internship_roles r JOIN public.companies c USING(company_id)
      WHERE r.active AND c.active) AS ok FROM valid
), removed AS (
  DELETE FROM public.internship_role_chunks old USING valid v,complete
  WHERE complete.ok AND old.metadata->>'dataset'='internship_roles'
    AND old.role_id=v.metadata->>'role_id' RETURNING old.id
), inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO public.internship_role_chunks(text,metadata,embedding)
  SELECT v.text,v.metadata,v.embedding::extensions.vector(3072) FROM valid v,complete,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM removed) barrier WHERE complete.ok RETURNING metadata
), marked AS (
  UPDATE public.role_documents d SET index_status='ready',embedding_model='models/gemini-embedding-001',embedding_dimensions=3072
  WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted i WHERE i.metadata->>'document_key'=d.document_key
     AND (i.metadata->>'source_version')::integer=d.source_version) RETURNING d.document_key
)
SELECT count(*) AS chunks_written,count(DISTINCT metadata->>'role_id') AS roles_indexed,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM incoming) AS expected_roles FROM inserted;

Previous index was preserved.');return [{json:{ok:true,roles_indexed:Number($json.roles_indexed),chunks_written:Number($json.chunks_written),embedding_model:'models/gemini-embedding-001',dimensions:3072}}];

## Manual administrator operation
Select an existing knowledge-writer Postgres credential in both SQL nodes and your saved Google Gemini(PaLM) Api credential in the embedding request. Execute this workflow once before search. It indexes the database sources, never resumes. A complete replacement is committed atomically; a failed embedding leaves the old index in place.
